provenance: This fixture is an ASR and turn-correction smoke check. It is not a booking-correctness check. A pass shows only that the pipeline transcribes the committed WAV and applies the spoken correction; a pass is not evidence of a correct or safe appointment write. See docs/reviews/CLAUDE_REVIEW_2026-09-15.md Package 3 item 1 for the original request. The fixture uses one real committed WAV file, tests/fixtures/audio/synthetic_pause_correction.wav. The script is: 'Book Tuesday. [1.5 s pause] Actually, Wednesday at five.' See docs/feedback/PROVENANCE.md for the WAV provenance. The script does not state AM or PM. For this reason, the oracle does not assert the hour argument or the committed effect; a committed hour is real ASR- and model-dependent evidence, reported in a live run but not scored here. Do not read a pass on this fixture as proof the model chose a safe or authorized appointment time. scenarios/live_dev/audio_correction_ambiguous_hour_clarification.json uses the same WAV and scores write safety around the ambiguous hour instead. A live run requires --components local and --asr-model-path <installed Faster Whisper base.en directory>. Offline-fake mode has no scripted proposals for this file, by design; it fails loudly instead of silently substituting a transcript for ASR.
